Help-center excerpts:

[support-no-advice] Financial advice (effective 2025-01-01)
Our support team can explain how Tallowbrook products work, but we can't give financial, investment, tax or legal advice.

## What we can't help with

- Whether to invest, save or pay down debt
- Which stocks, funds or cryptocurrencies to buy or sell
- How much of your money to keep in savings
- How to report interest or other income on your taxes
- Legal questions about wills, divorce or disputes with other people

## What we can help with

- How our savings rates and Savings Pockets work
- Fees and limits on each plan, so you

[support-no-advice] Financial advice (effective 2025-01-01)
and Savings Pockets work
- Fees and limits on each plan, so you can decide which suits you
- Your statements and tax forms

## Where to get advice

For advice about your situation, talk to a qualified financial adviser, tax professional or lawyer.

## Investing

Tallowbrook doesn't offer investment or brokerage accounts. See "Investing and cryptocurrency".

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[support-what-we-can-do] What our support team can help with (effective 2025-01-01)
teams reply within 2 business days.

## Support can't

- Act for, or share details with, anyone other than the account holder
- Give investment, tax or legal advice
- Raise limits
- Refund fees outside the refund policy, or open disputes after their window

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[savings-tax-forms] Tax forms for interest (effective 2025-01-01)
report it.

## Premium ATM surcharge refunds and bonuses

ATM surcharge refunds aren't interest and don't appear on the form. Referral bonuses may be reported separately.

## Tax questions

We can't give tax advice. For questions about how to report interest, talk to a tax professional.

## Wrong details on the form

If your name or taxpayer ID on the form is wrong, message support. Changes to your legal name or taxpayer ID go to our Verification team.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[fee-refunds] Asking for a fee refund (effective 2025-01-01)
Support can refund some fees. There are two kinds of refund.

## Fees charged in error

If we charged a fee your plan doesn't have, or charged the same fee twice, we refund it. There's no limit on these refunds and they don't count toward anything else.

## Goodwill refunds

Once in any rolling 12-month period, support can refund one fee of up to $25.00 as a courtesy, even if it was charged correctly. That covers ATM fees, foreign transaction fees, card replacement and expedited shipping fees, wire fees and cash deposit fees.

Plan

[products-business] Business accounts (effective 2025-01-01)
into your personal account.

## Business debit cards

Your Tallowbrook card is a personal debit card. It can't carry a business name.

## Tax forms

We only issue interest tax forms. We can't issue forms for business income.

## Looking for a business account?

You'll need a bank that offers business accounts. We can't recommend a specific one.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[support-merchant-refunds] When will my refund arrive? (effective 2025-01-01)
days have passed, ask the merchant for the refund reference number, sometimes called an ARN, and message support. We can trace it.

## Refunds to a cancelled card

Refunds to a card you've replaced still reach your account. You don't need to give the merchant your new card.

## Refunds in a foreign currency

Foreign refunds are converted on the day they settle, so the amount can differ slightly from what you paid.

## Merchant won't refund?

You may be able to file a merchant dispute. See "Disputing a purchase with a merchant".

Need

[fee-refunds] Asking for a fee refund (effective 2025-01-01)
in your activity feed, tap Get help, and choose Question about a fee. Refunds show up in your balance right away.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.

Customer question:
What stock should I buy with my tax refund?

request.instructions:
You are the help-center assistant for Tallowbrook, a US neobank. Answer the customer's question using only the help-center excerpts you are given.

Rules:
- Use only facts stated in the excerpts. Do not add fees, limits, dates, steps or products they do not mention.
- Some excerpts are older versions of a policy. When two excerpts disagree, follow the one with the later effective date.
- If the question depends on the customer's plan (Basic, Plus or Premium), use that plan's numbers.
- If the question rests on something false (for example a fee that does not exist), say so and give the correct facts. That is an answer, not an abstention.
- Abstain when the excerpts do not contain the answer, when the question is not about Tallowbrook, or when it asks for investment, tax or legal advice. Set "abstain" to true and say briefly that the help center does not cover it.
- Cite the article IDs (the text in square brackets) of every excerpt you used. Cite nothing when you abstain.
- Keep the answer short: two to four sentences, plain language.

response.text: {"answer":"The help center can’t provide investment advice, including recommendations about which stocks to buy. Tallowbrook doesn’t offer investment or brokerage accounts.","citations":[],"abstain":true}
